# OmniFit Performance

> OmniFit Performance is a private 1-on-1 personal training and corrective exercise practice in San Diego, specializing in joint-friendly strength training, executive posture correction, and sustainable coaching for professionals over 30.

## Core Information
- **Founder:** Nemezio LopezPerez. Thirteen certifications: NASM Elite Trainer (CPT, CES, PES, BCS, CNC); ACE Corrective Exercise Specialist; four Precision Nutrition certifications, including Level 2 Master Health Coach; three Eden certifications in clinical collaboration for GLP-1 and peptide protocols.
- **Location:** Inside Teqneeq Functional Health Center, 10772 Thornmint Rd, San Diego, CA 92127 (4S Ranch).
- **Service model:** In-studio training, in-home personal training across North County San Diego, and live virtual coaching nationwide. Studio and in-home sessions are 60 minutes.
- **Methodology:** A four-phase framework, Assess, Correct, Build, Sustain, using a 3/10 pain ceiling rule.
- **Consultation:** 45 minutes by video or phone, preceded by an intake form. $30 refundable deposit, refunded the same day the consultation is attended.
- **Assessment:** In-person Performance Assessment, $150, credited toward the first program cycle, an Executive Reset, or a session pack. Movement screen, resting heart rate and blood pressure, girth measurements, and Bodystat QuadScan 4000 body composition analysis. Virtual clients complete a $75 self-measured assessment with video guidance, credited the same way.
- **Reviews:** 4.98 average across 190+ reviews.
- **Scope:** OmniFit Performance is a personal training practice, not a medical provider. It does not diagnose, treat, manage hormonal health, or provide physical therapy, and refers to licensed clinicians when a situation calls for one.

### Who the Training Is Built For
- [Training After 50](https://www.omnifittraining.com/personal-trainer-over-50-san-diego) - Strength training for men and women over 50. Longer connective-tissue recovery windows, volume before intensity, and the hormonal context of later decades.
- [Desk Worker Posture and Pain](https://www.omnifittraining.com/desk-worker-posture-pain) - Upper and lower crossed syndrome from prolonged sitting, and the corrective approach to both.
- [Couples and Partner Training](https://www.omnifittraining.com/couples-personal-training-san-diego) - One session, two separate programs, split where goals or capacity differ. Rates are per couple.
- [Corrective Exercise and Post-Rehab](https://www.omnifittraining.com/corrective-exercise-post-rehab) - Post-PT bridge training for clients cleared by a clinician.
- [Training on a GLP-1](https://www.omnifittraining.com/glp-1-personal-training-san-diego) - Resistance-priority programming for clients prescribed semaglutide or tirzepatide, built to preserve lean mass during rapid weight loss. OmniFit does not prescribe or advise on the medication.

### Programs and Pricing
- [How It Works and Pricing](https://www.omnifittraining.com/how-it-works-pricing) - Program tiers, upfront costs, and billing policies.

- [The 30-Minute Executive Reset](https://www.omnifittraining.com/the-30-minute-executive-reset) - Live virtual coaching for professionals who travel.
- [In-Home Training](https://www.omnifittraining.com/in-home-personal-trainer-san-diego) - Mobile training across North County and coastal San Diego.
- [Nutrition Coaching](https://www.omnifittraining.com/nutrition-coaching-san-diego) - Behavior-based nutrition coaching on a four-phase framework: awareness, regulation, adaptation, integration. Macro targets, meal frameworks, and AI photo logging. Included in every training tier at the same depth.
- [Behavior Change Coaching](https://www.omnifittraining.com/behavior-change-coaching) - Four stages: Awareness, Regulation, Adaptation, Integration, paired with the training framework.
- [HSA and FSA Eligibility](https://www.omnifittraining.com/hsa-fsa-personal-training) - When personal training qualifies as a medical expense, what a Letter of Medical Necessity is, and how reimbursement works. Eligibility is determined by a licensed provider, not by OmniFit.
